title: Gibson band hymns, marches and rehearsal habits; closing
summary: Hymns and the Gibson March played by the Gibson band, weekly Thursday rehearsals versus rare Eureka and frequent Kid Rena rehearsals, then the recording is stopped.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Do you have any questions, Molly?

Not that I can think of right now. Yeah, I thought maybe you had something special on funeral bands or something like that. What are some of the hymns that you all play with the Gibson band? That's one thing I'd like to know. Well the Gibson, they play all those hymns. They play by and by when the morning comes, walk through the streets of the city, over in the glory land, saints. That's about all I can remember. And then they play, they have a march they play. What's the name of that march? We just call the name of that march. Well there's one special march they have, they call it the Gibson March. That's their own make-up. Do they ever play Maryland? Yeah, Maryland. They do play Maryland. That's it. That's about the two marches they play, the Maryland and the E Gibson special. And let's see, do they play any songs, like blues or anything like that ever? Well they play the St. Louis blues, Chic, yeah they play a good many songs. Yeah. Sunny side of the street. Every week. Unless it's a holiday or something happen. Mm-hm. Well we'll get in touch with you if we come. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. That's about all. How often do you rehearse? Well it's every Thursday. Every week. Unless it's a holiday or something happens. Yeah but we could come sometime. I'd be glad to have you there. Well we'll get in touch with you if we come. I'd be glad. Let me see now. What about the Eureka? How often did they rehearse on those times? Well the Eureka would very seldom have rehearsal. Very seldom. What would you do when you wanted to play a new march or something like that? Well that's when they would have rehearsal. See when they'd get a new number they'd call it rehearsal. Otherwise they wouldn't have rehearsal. I guess they knew the stuff pretty well. That's right. They could read pretty good. What about Rene? How often would he have rehearsals if ever? Well Rene would rehearse them. You mean with the Eureka? No Rene. Or Kid Rene. Kid Rene? Kid Rene, not Remy. He would have rehearsals. He'd have rehearsals maybe about three times a month. Yeah he believed in rehearsals. Kid Rene, huh? Yeah. And what would he rehearse you on? Would he rehearse you on the head numbers? Yeah. No music at all. I never knew him to have any music. Mostly head numbers. So you'd work it all out like that, huh? Mm-hmm. Can we stop this just about a minute? Yeah. Yeah, I think we should cut it off nine. .
